categories.title: Categories (discovery mode)
categories.description: Kalshi categories to browse, e.g. Politics, Economics, Sports, Financials, Climate and Weather, Science and Technology, Culture, World, Health, Companies, Crypto. Matched loosely.

keywords.title: Keywords (optional)
keywords.description: Only markets whose event title or outcome mentions one of these, e.g. Fed, inflation, Chiefs, Bitcoin.

eventTickers.title: Event tickers (optional)
eventTickers.description: Exact Kalshi event tickers to fetch, e.g. KXNEWPOPE-70. Overrides categories and series.

seriesTickers.title: Series tickers (optional)
seriesTickers.description: Kalshi series tickers to fetch all markets from, e.g. KXFED, KXCPI.

status.title: Market status
status.description: Open markets trade now; closed and settled are history.

onlyPriced.title: Only markets with prices
onlyPriced.description: Skip markets that have no bids and no trades yet (empty books, long-dated combos).

minVolume.title: Min volume (contracts)
minVolume.description: Skip markets with lifetime volume below this.

maxRows.title: Max market rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on market rows returned. Controls total cost.
